data.body_html:
Andalusia Day (28 February 2041) is a public holiday in southern Spain — a day when locals and visitors alike celebrate Andalusian culture, history, and the Mediterranean lifestyle. Instead of spending it on a crowded beach or in a tapas bar, consider a Marbella boat rental for Andalusia Day 2041. Charter a boat from Puerto Banús and spend the day cruising the Costa del Sol with friends, family, or colleagues. Prices start at €749 for two hours, with skipper, drinks, and snacks included.

Our fleet offers something for every group size and budget. From the compact Marbella boat rental options to the spacious Mangusta 80, you can celebrate Andalusia Day on the water in style. Below, you will find everything you need to plan your charter.

Why charter a boat for Andalusia Day?

Andalusia Day is a Thursday in 2041, making it an ideal day for a long weekend escape. The weather in late February is mild — average sea temperatures around 15°C and air temperatures hitting 18°C. The coast is quieter than summer, so you can anchor at Cala del Faro or Cala Cortés without the crowds. A boat rental gives you freedom: swim, sunbathe, and enjoy the views of La Concha mountain.

Our fleet for Andalusia Day 2041

We operate 17 boats from Puerto Banús. Here are the most popular choices for a celebration:

  • Astondoa 40 (12.5m, 9 guests) — €749/2h, €2,299/8h
  • Azimut 39 (12.5m, 11 guests) — €749/2h, €2,299/8h
  • Mangusta 80 (24m, 12 guests) — from €4,719/4h (includes free jet ski)
  • Azimut 58 Flybridge (17.6m, 12 guests) — pricing on request
  • Ferretti 94 (29m, 12 guests) — pricing on request

All charters include a licensed skipper, fuel, insurance, water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, light snacks, and 21% VAT. No hidden extras.

What to expect on the day

Your charter begins at Puerto Banús. After a safety briefing, you will cruise along the Marbella coastline. Typical itineraries include passing the Golden Mile, stopping for a swim near Cabopino, and heading towards Estepona or Sotogrande if time allows. The skipper will handle navigation and anchoring. You can bring your own music and food — the boat has a cool box and a sound system.

Booking tips for Andalusia Day 2041

Andalusia Day is popular, so book early. Contact us via WhatsApp to check availability. We recommend the 4-hour or 8-hour charter to make the most of the day. If you choose a Tier B boat like the Mangusta 80, you get a free jet ski — perfect for exploring the coast. Deposit is required to secure the booking, with balance due on the day.
